annotations.title: Get cited page text (uses a key credit)

description: Fetch a public URL and return its cited, paragraph-addressable text with integrity hashes and a receipt. Uses one credit from a ProofFetch key, and only when extraction succeeds. Needs the key sent as the MCP request header Authorization: Bearer <key>: a free key holds 1,000 extractions (no card, POST /v1/keys/free or the ProofFetch home page); a paid key holds 500 for $5.00 (sold on the ProofFetch home page). Example: {"url":"https://example.com/"}.

extract.description: Fill a JSON schema from the page's own structured data, no AI: each field is read from a CSS selector you give (selectors or the field's x-selector), else JSON-LD, meta tags or microdata. derived.extract.sources names where each value came from; fields with no source come back null and are listed in missing.

formats.description: Optional extra outputs in derived: markdown (clean Markdown with headings, lists, tables and links; the main content by default), links (every link on the page, absolute, marked internal or not), metadata (title, description, author, dates, Open Graph, JSON-LD). Each is fingerprinted (derived.sha256) and can be recomputed from the page bytes with the open verifier.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. The same value on a retry within 7 days returns the stored result without using a second credit; a call without one is a new purchase.

images.description: With markdown: keep images as ![alt](src) (true, the default) or leave them out.

maxChars.description: Maximum normalized characters to extract. Free preflight returns metadata plus a preview of about the first 1,000 characters.

onlyMainContent.description: With markdown: leave out menus, headers, footers, cookie notices and sidebars (true, the default) or keep the whole page (false).

removeSelector.description: With markdown: drop the parts of the page matching this CSS selector before reading, for example ".ads, .comments".

targetSelector.description: With markdown: read only the parts of the page matching this CSS selector, for example "article" or "#pricing".

url.description: Required: the address of one public web page or PDF, for example https://example.com/; a bare domain such as example.com also works. Not a search phrase or placeholder. No credentials, private networks, authenticated pages or browser rendering.
